articles.summary: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.
articles.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?

articles.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang

articles.summary: Some governments moved to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations.
articles.title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit

articles.summary: Bloomberg Technology co-host Ed Ludlow tells Bloomberg This Weekend why Anthropic’s upcoming IPO could be a major test of investor appetite for AI, with the offering heavily oversubscribed and poised to follow SpaceX’s blockbuster debut. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ludlow also explains how Nvidia and Jensen Huang’s departure loom over the offering, given Nvidia’s planned investment in Anthropic and Huang’s central role connecting the companies powering the AI boom. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title: Anthropic IPO Tests Investor Appetite for AI

articles.summary: Today, I’m talking with Helen Toner, the executive director of the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University. articles.title: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs

articles.summary: Indian stocks suffered bruising losses in the first nine months of the year as the artificial intelligence trade hoovered up global investor capital. The unwinding of that strategy has turned the Asian nation’s equities into world beaters.
articles.title: India Stock Market Rebounds as AI Trade Unwinds, Foreign Funds Return

articles.summary: Bloomberg senior technology and strategic industries editor Mike Shepard tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Nvidia’s appointment of longtime CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO may offer investors some stability after Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Shepard examines how Nvidia moves beyond a leader who defined the company for more than three decades and whether the upheaval creates an opening for AI chip rivals. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title: Nvidia’s Leadership Shakeup Tests AI Chip Giant

articles.summary: Bloomberg’s Emily Chang tells Bloomberg This Weekend what her recent interview with Jensen Huang reveals about Nvidia’s succession challenge after the longtime CEO’s abrupt departure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Chang examines who could succeed Huang, the questions surrounding Nvidia’s China strategy and whether the AI giant can preserve the influence and relationships Huang built over more than three decades. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title: Nvidia Looks for a New Era After Huang
